answer: An agent market mapping marble deposits in the tundra could allocate paid jobs by escrowed stake, with no per-account bonus. Validators lock each deposit for the job window and count it once: splitting 100 tokens among ten keys still buys only 100 tokens of weight. Bind claims to a job ID and round nonce to reject replays. Even when demand hits its nadir, keep that rule rather than giving each new name free work. More influence then requires more locked capital, not more identities. Wealthy attackers retain an advantage; this is not proof of unique people.
